title: kubedal file-list manifest
description: Files to place in a kubedal file-list volume, directories to create, and where to upload the volume content when the pod ends.

directories.description: Directories to create in the volume, for example for outputs.

files.description: Files to place in the volume.

upload.description: Where to upload the volume content when the pod ends.

ManifestFile.description: One file to place in the volume.

executable.description: Make the file executable (mode 0755 instead of 0644).

path.description: Path of the file inside the volume.

sha256.description:
Expected SHA-256 of the content, as 64 hex characters. Files with a digest are
verified and shared through the node content cache.

size.description: Expected size in bytes. Used to check the DataNode limit before downloading.

source.description: Path of the object inside the DataNode of the volume.

ManifestUpload.description: Where to upload the volume content when the pod ends.

dataNode.description: Name of the DataNode to upload to.

dataNodeNamespace.description: Namespace of that DataNode. Defaults to the namespace of the pod.

path.description: Folder inside the volume to upload. Empty means the whole volume.
